subject: Geografia

components.description_pt: Identificar os principais domínios morfoclimáticos da Europa, Ásia e Oceania
components.description_en: Identify the main morphoclimatic domains of Europe, Asia, and Oceania

components.description_pt: Comparar domínios morfoclimáticos em diferentes regiões da Europa, Ásia e Oceania
components.description_en: Compare morphoclimatic domains across different regions of Europe, Asia, and Oceania
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how interactions among Earth's systems vary across different geographic locations to influence climate

cc_matches.description: Weather and climate are influenced by interactions involving sunlight, the ocean, the atmosphere, ice, landforms, and living things. These interactions vary with latitude, altitude, and local and regional geography, all of which can affect oceanic and atmospheric flow patterns.
